reading.body:
The only fact this record establishes about Melva Wallace is her role: President and CEO of Huston-Tillotson University in Austin, Texas. It contains no evidence of AI work.

The entry sits under Advocates and Public Voices, and its single timeline item is her current presidency. The hook, the quoted headline, the achievement, and the quick fact all restate the same position in slightly different words. What the record shows is that the AI ecosystem taxonomy counts university leadership as a category of participant, and that inclusion here rests on institutional role rather than on any documented activity in AI.

That distinction matters because universities feed AI through trained graduates and research capacity, and the president of a historically Black university is a plausible voice in arguments about who gets access to that pipeline. This record does not say she has taken any position on AI. It names no program, no partnership, no funder, and no date beyond "Current." The category assignment is the entire link.

It also says nothing about compute, buildings, or power, which is the part of the ecosystem this entry cannot speak to. There is no founding date, no nationality, and no secondary source. The one source is a LinkedIn profile. Read it as a directory entry confirming a title, not as evidence of an AI role.
